full_page.content:
1943, September & December
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of message written by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap. on a Seraphic Mass Association Card.
Phillip Schreiner
- for speedy recovery, God willing. September 15, 1943
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
God bless you Phillip and Aunt Beatrice too. Get well amd keep up. Fr. S.
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of short messages written on holy pictures by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
Feast of St. Nicholas (Dec. 12)
God bless you Miss Lamb.
And many thanks for favor of Nov. 24th Please God -
- - Philip's arm will be all okay. I am so pleased that you find things so favorable over there. Thank God. Hope it con- tinues so God's blessing for the holy season so near. I am mailing picture as requested. God bless you all.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.C.
Feast of St. Nicholas (December 6th, 1943)
God bless you Philip DeSchryver.
: Hope your arm will come out a hundred % Okay. Keep courage. Go to Communion .. Be a real "little-boy-friend of Jesus and Mary. And don't forget to remember poor me to them.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Originals in possession of: Miss Beatrice Lamb 36087 Bartell St. Richmond, Michigan 48062
